name: Dank News RSS & Ticker Pill
description: Scrolling headlines inside the DankBar. Companion to the ‘Dank News RSS & Ticker’ desktop widget, which owns the feeds — this one only displays them. Add it to a bar section here, then open its settings (Plugins → Dank News RSS & Ticker Pill) and set ‘Scrolling headlines’ to ‘In the bar (pill)’.
author: Xn4m3d
